actual_scope: Consolidated statement under the stated hypotheses (shortest rank-one root, coordinate output-frame masks, whole-job credit): D_root >= f(8L+1)+2 sum_{m=1..g}[f(8m+1)-f(8m-8)], equality only for chain(g|g) and its twin; Dieudonne n+1 with a direct rigidity proof; star optimality for N=2..1199; no block root pays (all 384 partitions of 18, best -4.8%); e=1 break-even 1120.2 against a conditional floor of 1276.0; D_root formula derived from the #6833 invoice to 1e-40; dense x and y exact for L<=8 and proved for all L when every field has one host; D-free bases a verifier convention with D-jobs priced. Twisted site-frame masks are closed at L=2 and open for L>=4.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a joint helper basis and a legal causal split on the complete invoice. This package is a structural optimality statement about the root mask family; it builds no word and prices nothing beyond the root formula.
bottleneck_link: docs/research/research-family-status.md; the statement fixes a necessary condition on the owned-move events of any legal native and which end-shortening edits of the #6833 owned layer it excludes.
stop_rule: No kappa claim. Open and stated: twisted site-frame masks for L>=4 (not forced by the verifier's rules), shared-host fields and pivot rows at L>=10, roots with e>=2 extra units and R2/R3 at e=1, the J-staircase lemma for constant bases plus uncredited D-jobs, rank-2 units, non-coordinate masks. No word is constructed.
evidence: README.md and THEOREM.md (statements and proofs), check.py with base_check.py and root_check.py (exact certificates), supp/ (decision logs, #6833 invoice data, enumerator source, twisted-site script).

open_questions.question: Do twisted site-frame masks (P_k = U_k E_k U_k^-1 != E_k) ever lower D_root for L >= 4?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The chain optimality theorem assumes P_k = E_k; it is closed at L=2 (no twisted root below 90.854 > 87.7147) but not beyond.
open_questions.first_step: Exclude twisted sites with |S|=2 at n=6, k in 2..4, then price the |S|>=3 patterns with a credit cap that reproduces chain(2|2)=217.993.
open_questions.blocked_by: The n=4 Groebner exclusion has 32 unknowns; n=6 has 72 and was not solved.

open_questions.question: Can the all-L single-host theorem be extended to fields shared by several hosts and pivot rows at L>=10?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Removes the last unproved part of dropping R2.
open_questions.first_step: Find an inequality charging each extra host incidence (>= f(9)) against the deficit c(m) - F(m,h)/h.
open_questions.blocked_by: The margin at L=18 is thin and shrinks with L.
